name: toolscout
description: Compacts the deferred tool list into one line per MCP server and, on every message, suggests the relevant tool groups, chosen by TypeSafe's Jev model.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for TypeSafe's Jev model. Without it toolscout only compacts the tool list.

server_labels.title: Server labels
server_labels.description: Readable names for connectors that appear as UUIDs, as <server id>=<name>, separated by semicolons.
